svg.title: Ligconsolata Next Catalog
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 207 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Detailed left-right samples from the current Ligconsolata Next font.
当前 Ligconsolata Next 字体的详细左右对比样例。
